_about: The kanban vocabulary: boards and their ordered columns, cards and the moves that carry them across, work-in-progress limits, blockers, explicit policies and replenishment meetings, and the people and teams who pull, decide and are waited on. A card's column is never written on the card: each move is recorded and kept, so where it is now is its latest move and the moves are its history. Limits are kept the same way. Counting and durations are worked out when a question is answered, from the moves and dates the question returns.
name: kanban

Board.definition: A team's kanban board: the columns its work flows through, the policies it makes explicit, and how long it tells people a card should take.

Column.definition: A step on a board that cards pass through, in order, marked as waiting, being worked on, or done.
Column.scope_note: A swimlane is not a column: a column is a step in the flow, a lane cuts across all of them.

Card.definition: A piece of work that flows across a board: when it was asked for, how urgent it is, when it is due, and who is working on it.

Move.definition: A card entering a column on a date. Recorded when it happens and never edited or superseded: where a card is now is its latest move, and its moves are its history.
Move.scope_note: One move per card per day: a card that moves twice in a day is recorded where it ended up that day, because flow is read per day and dates are compared, not times.
Move.example: Saved cards at checkout moved out of Doing into Review on 2026-09-10.

WipLimit.label: work-in-progress limit
WipLimit.definition: The most cards a column may hold, set from a date, with why and who decided. A change is a new limit; the earlier ones stay as the record of what was decided.
WipLimit.scope_note: The limit a column has now is its latest one; a column with none is unlimited.

Blocker.definition: A card stopped because it waits on something: since when, when it cleared, why, and on what or whom.
Blocker.scope_note: A blocker is the card stopping, not a column: a blocked card stays in its column.

Policy.definition: A rule a board or a column makes explicit: what must be true for a card to enter or leave a column, the definition of done, or how the team works the board.

Replenishment.label: replenishment meeting
Replenishment.definition: A meeting where a board's team chooses which cards to pull in next: when it was held, who decided, which cards came in.

Person.definition: A named individual who works on cards, takes a decision about the board, or is waited on.

Team.definition: A team that owns a board, and that another team's work can wait on.

column_of.definition: The board this column is a step of. Exactly one: a column belongs to one board.

owned_by.definition: The team whose board this is: the one that sets its columns, limits and policies.

worked_by.definition: Who is working on the card now. Superseded when someone else picks it up.

move_of.definition: The card this move moves. Exactly one: a move of nothing, or of two cards, is not a move.

out_of.label: out of
out_of.definition: The column the card left. Absent on a card's first move onto the board.

limits.definition: The column this limit applies to.

decided_by.definition: Who took the decision: set the limit, or chose what to pull in.

waits_on.label: waits on
waits_on.definition: Whom or what the blocked card waits on: a person to answer, a team to deliver, another card to be done.

applies_to.definition: The column or board the policy governs. A policy of a column holds for that step; a policy of the board holds everywhere on it.

policy_of.label: policy of
policy_of.definition: The board a policy holds on, its own or one of its columns'. Derived, never asserted: the rules policy-of-the-board and policy-of-a-column write it.

replenishes.definition: The board whose work this meeting chose.

pulled_in.label: pulled in
pulled_in.definition: A card the meeting chose to pull onto the board.

expected_days.label: expected days
expected_days.definition: How many days the team tells people a card takes from the start of work to done: the 10 in "85% within 10 days".

expected_share.label: expected share
expected_share.definition: The percentage of cards the team expects to finish within the expected days: the 85 in "85% within 10 days".

position.definition: Where the column sits on its board, counted from the left starting at 1. A move to a lower position is a move backwards.

kind.label: column kind
kind.definition: What a card in the column is doing: waiting to be pulled, being worked on, or done. Cycle time starts at the first move into a working column.

requested_on.label: requested on
requested_on.definition: When someone asked for the work: where lead time starts.

class_of_service.label: class of service
class_of_service.definition: How urgent the card is: standard, expedite (urgent, ahead of everything else) or fixed date (worthless after its due date).

due.definition: The date the card must be done by, when it has one.

moved_on.label: moved on
moved_on.definition: The day the card entered the column.

max_cards.label: maximum cards
max_cards.definition: The most cards the column may hold at once.

set_on.label: set on
set_on.definition: The day the limit took effect.

reason.definition: Why the limit was set or changed, in the team's words.

cleared_on.label: cleared on
cleared_on.definition: The day the card could move again. Absent while it is still blocked.

reason.definition: Why the card stopped, in the team's words.

applies_when.label: applies when
applies_when.definition: When the policy is checked: as a card enters the column, as it leaves (a definition of done), or always.

statement.definition: What the policy says must be true, in the team's words.

held_on.label: held on
held_on.definition: The day the meeting was held.
